name: First steps with Jesus
promise: Six days for new believers, on the cross, the new birth, the life you have received, and the first responsibilities of the new creation.
why: Welcome home. Giving your life to Jesus is the beginning, and beginnings deserve good foundations. These six sessions walk the first steps slowly: what the cross did to your old nature, how the new birth wakes your spiritual senses, the life you have actually received and how it is kept, the second breath Jesus gives, how to close the doors of the past, and the first responsibilities of the new creation, starting with your own household. Take them one day at a time.

days.theme: Crucified with Christ: the old nature is dealt with
days.key_quote: It was an exchange that happened.

days.theme: Born again: your spiritual senses are awake
days.key_quote: If the Spirit of God comes into the space of your heart, He will activate your spiritual senses.

days.theme: The life you have received: knowing God
days.key_quote: God cannot be known cerebrally. God must be known experientially.

days.theme: The second breath: a new kind of life
days.key_quote: This is the second breath; the first breath was in Adam.

days.theme: Clearance of the past: closing old doors
days.key_quote: We need to put a closure to our devotion, to our worship, to our transactions with any possible idols, deities and gods that we were involved with.

days.theme: New creation responsibilities: do not travel alone
days.key_quote: When you are saved, you are not supposed to travel alone.
